count_policy: Eleven consolidated correctness amendment groups: eight overlap the frozen partial controls, three consolidate further correctness mechanisms. This is not eleven independently discovered implementation defects; variants, repeated stages and optional proposals do not increase this count. Actual landing requires the verified scoped repository commit.
scope: Synthetic Slide Scout fixture only; no Puppet Master feature, dependency choice, implementation or runtime acceptance. All optional product choices remain unanswered.
source_limits: Primary links identify evidence; acquired hashes and source catalogs bind inspected bytes. v0.5 schema references are captured branch content, not asserted immutable tags.
native_union_scoring: Eight of eight partial controls on complementary comparison reports, including an explicitly adjudicated C02 union. Earlier per-stage/per-job limitations remain in stage review; exact evaluator wording is not credited as native text.
